scope: Bounded 3-encoder by 2-granularity detector follow-up. Whole summarization domain is held out. Earlier domains are development data. No held-out score chooses a head.
features: Same generic observed-text segmentation, 64-word cap, all text covered by <=256-token windows with stride192. Eight pooled/relation vectors; encoder-prescribed pooling/prefix. Mean/max segments replace old fixed windows, so old scores are not controlled before/after comparisons.
training: 200 source/near-duplicate groups from BIPIA TableQA; duplicate identical group/question/span/label rows collapsed. Source/class balanced weights, train-only weighted standardization, C=1 balanced logistic regression max2000. Span supervision uses known construction offsets only in training, never inference.
calibration: Known email/table/code corpora. Document risk is max segment score. Primary measured operating point maximizes worst-domain source-balanced recall under per-domain point FPR<=5%; tie mean recall, lower maximum FPR, higher threshold. Confidence selector remains unchanged: minimum100 benign groups/domain, familywise one-sided bounds<=5%, recall>=50%. Email has only78 independent groups, so confidence qualification must report insufficient support; exploratory point metrics must not be called certified.
final: 100 reconstructed official BIPIA XSum test sources, MD5-verified; 6 published attacks/source plus clean. No final source used in fitting or calibration. No unseen attack-family or foundation-pretraining independence claim.
head_selection: Worst calibration-domain recall, then average recall, then lower max FPR, then predefined encoder/granularity order. All heads frozen before final feature computation. All six final cells reported.
runtime: MPS FP32 eager attention, fixed seed20261029, batch16, CPU threads4; no mixed precision or backbone updates.
